_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Parts, Materials, and Processes (PM&P) Management Exception Data
summary: Provides tabular exception data documenting DoD parts, materials, and processes selections that do not meet government preferences, including risk type, manufacturer information, reason, and mitigations.
use_relationship:
The PM&P Management Exception Data will allow the government to assess the possible risk created by selecting or procuring a part in the design of a DoD item and to take action as a function of risk if the rationale for selecting the part and the associated mitigations are insufficient. It will also be used to verify that the contractor's parts selection processes are effective when the government uses the data in the reports to create metrics for specific part selection risks. The contractor's PM&P Management Plan describes its parts, materials, and processes selection, including responsibilities for the evaluation, documentation, and notification of part changes. The selection processes also address the allocation of system performance requirements to parts' technical requirements. The selection processes take into consideration performance tolerances, and define parts' qualification requirements to meet system performance, reliability, quality, and safety requirements. The exceptions identified in the PM&P Management Exception Data indicate areas where the contractor's processes resulted in a part selection that does not meet government preferences. The exceptions therefore identify a minimum set of parts for the government to either approve or reject and help prioritize government efforts if an entire parts list is being reviewed. This data is also used to track operations of DoD weapons systems and ensure DoD is achieving operational readiness objectives.
a. The data may be obtained during any life-cycle phase.
b. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product implied by the requirements in the current version of MIL-STD-11991.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The PM&P Management Exception Data shall be provided in tabular format with the Field Names in Table 1 as the column labels.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The data shall contain all the information specified by the Data Element Numbers in Table 1. The data shall meet the requirements as specified in the Definition, Notes and Instructions, and Data Type columns of Table 1.
